context:
Phase 3 SSB cutover (owner decision A3). Separated from Tier 1 and Tier 3 synthetic cutovers so SSB's external pvm-p2/crr-c2 dependencies do not delay unrelated benchmarks.

Parked 2026-11-25 by owner decision: the datagen target is now a BenchBox-owned Rust library (see datagen-adr-rust-library-revision). This item waits for the revised ADR, which decides whether it is rebuilt around the library or dropped.
description:
## Problem
Once datagen-p2-ssb-versioned-migration validates the new versioned SSB generator and bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus ensures published results carry data_generation_hash, SSB's default backend can flip cleanly without breaking v1 reproducibility.

## Change
- Verify bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus and datagen-p2-ssb-versioned-migration are done and all Gate A, Gate C, and Gate D checks pass on every supported platform.
- Flip ssb in benchbox/utils/datagen_backend.py's default table to the new versioned SSB generator while retaining --datagen-backend legacy (v1 random.Random(42) stream and v1 SSB_EXPECTED_ROW_COUNTS) for at least one minor release.
- Add a changelog.d/ fragment documenting the versioned SSB generator cutover and provenance separation ([CHANGELOG-001]).

## Decision gates
- Hard blocked on bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus and datagen-p2-ssb-versioned-migration closing with owner-approved Gate C acceptance report.
- Stop and report if v1 vs v2 SSB runs collide in shared datagen/ folders or produce identical data_generation_hash values.

## Guardrails
- Never bump global DATA_GENERATION_VERSION; use SSB's per-benchmark version only.
- Never remove --datagen-backend legacy or v1 SSB_EXPECTED_ROW_COUNTS in this item.
- Follow AGENTS.md ([CHANGELOG-001], [RUN-DATA-001], [COMMENT-POLICY-001], linked worktree, make pr-preflight, merged PR).
